========================================
Statement-block macros and braced temporaries
========================================

void f(void) {
  ON_SCOPE_EXIT { cleanup(); };
  OStream s{&buf};
  Foo x{a, b};
  erase_fixture{}.run();
  if (cond) ON_SCOPE_EXIT { g(); };
  for (;;) LOG { flush(); };
  MACRO { x = 1'000; };
  ON_SCOPE_EXIT { if (ready) {} };
  Widget w{[&]{init();}};
  auto w2 = Widget{R"x(a "b" ; c)x"};
  MACRO { [[likely]] { f(); } }
  MACRO { int Rif = R"delim(a;b)delim"; auto s = u8R"xy(y;x)xy"; }
  MACRO { int q = 'A;' + '}x' + 1'000; }
  T t{sizeof(const int)};
  Widget w3{[&](int a, int b) mutable {init();}};
  Widget{[&]{init();}}.run();
}

---

================================================================================
Probe edge cases: hex separators, u8 chars, slash strings, attributes, namespace
================================================================================

void f(void) {
  MACRO { int v = 0xAB'CD; };
  MACRO { int b = u8'a'; };
  MACRO { auto p = base/"relative"; };
  MACRO { [[deprecated("a]]b")]] f(); };
  MACRO { namespace ns { int x; } };
}
---

              (identifier)
              (number_literal)))))
      (macro_braced_statement

              (identifier)
              (char_literal
                (character))))))

================================================================================
Braced macros with arguments: declarations, expressions, member position
================================================================================

SCOPE_GUARD(g_ams_iram_page_spin_lock) {
  ReleaseSpinLock(g_ams_iram_page_spin_lock);
};

struct S {
  MACRO(int a, int b) {
    int member;
  };
};

void f(void) {
  auto g = SCOPE_GUARD(x) { Unlock(); };
  R_TRY_CATCH(e) { work(); };
}
---

          (declaration
            (primitive_type)
            (identifier))))))
  (function_definition

      (identifier)
      (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          (primitive_type))))

struct Widget {
  PRIVILEGED_MEMBERS(int tag) {
    int flags : 3;
    friend class Helper;
  public:
    int value;
  };
};

================================================================================

  S() { this->x = 1; };

================================================================================
operator[] inside a class macro vs lambda captures elsewhere
================================================================================

struct S {
  MACRO(int t) {
    int operator[](int i) { return t[i]; }
  };
};

void f(void) {
  Widget{factory.operator()([] { return 1; })};
}

---

(translation_unit

                  (primitive_type)
                  (identifier))))

              (return_statement
                (subscript_expression
                  (identifier)
                  (subscript_argument_list
                    (identifier))))))))))
  (function_definition
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          (primitive_type))))
    (compound_statement
      (expression_statement

================================================================================
braced macro: operator name carries a comment before []
================================================================================

struct S {
  MACRO(int t) {
    int operator /*c*/ [](int i) { return t[i]; }
  };
};
